notes: lavasight-01 (mineshaft-safety F5b; OWNER 2026-10-24: right after lavastep-01, fed from the per-seed hazard map from day one). THE CHANGE: the walk profile (and every clone of it) carries a move wrapper that adds 50 to the cost of any move the corridor guard would refuse for a remembered lava cell -- the move judged in the form the guard is handed (postProcessPath's support tops, raw after a dig, the floored start). The move graph is the base's (nothing deleted, nothing added). Memory = the per-world lava-map.json the host publisher writes from ~/hazardmap/out/hazardmap.json (bound by hashedSeed and pool name; stale_after honoured; fail open) + the bot's own guard-named cells; re-read live every 20 s. Off while a body-moving reflex holds the body. homefix relocation never targets beside live remembered lava. LAVASIGHT=0 = the base apart from the licence row. MEASURED out of sample 10-24: 219 of 224 distinct guard-refused lava cells (97.8%) within 1 of a map cell (null 0.0%). Record: docs/reports/lavasight-01-design-2026-10-24.md. TIER 3: routing-wide.
lint: eslint no-undef on this tip: exactly one hit, bots/src/reflex.mjs 'withinBody' -- the pre-existing guarded line.

licence.note: Only a lavasight-01 build writes _lavasight_mode (on=1 state=...), at spawn and on every file-state change.

draw_exposure.note: Design 7: worlds whose bots the corridor guard refuses for lava (10-24: 13 of 16 worlds pass in 4.5 h). REQUIRES the publisher installed before the draw (install-lavamap.sh --install): the read's mapped gate needs a lava-map.json in each canary pool.

exposure.note: canary priced moves >= 200, >= 30 canary lava refusal episodes, and >= 80% of canary bots mapped.

own_lines.note: G2 (tripwire): a surcharge applied while a body-moving reflex held the body. 0 by construction; a mutant shows it fires.
G3 (tripwire): a wrapped generator returned a different neighbour count than the base (a wall).
G5: a canary _lavasight row without its gate fields (never a pass).
G4 ARMS: a control _lavasight* row after the deploy. BLOCKS KEEP.
LIVENESS: a canary licence on=1. BLOCKS KEEP.
MAPPED: >= 80% of ALL canary bots with newest mode state ok (the publisher reached them). BLOCKS KEEP.
INSTRUMENT: liveness coverage >= 0.75 of the canary's observed 10-min slots, both arms present. BLOCKS KEEP.

PRIMARY (pre-declared; Claude r2 P2-2, r4 P2-1): lava refusal episodes per bot-h, DiD canary v control, <= -0.5 -- a fall beyond the whole null range (4 base-build dry runs, roughly two independent windows: -0.48 .. +0.96 on rates of ~1-2/bot-h). So a KEEP means the episodes FELL, not merely that nothing objected; a smaller or absent fall closes INCONCLUSIVE. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE, not REVERT).
NO-HARM: path_timeout per bot-h DiD <= +6. Null (4 base-build dry runs, 180 min, 4 pools): -4.5 .. +2.3; base ~19/bot-h. BLOCKS KEEP.
NO-HARM: path_noPath per bot-h DiD <= +50. Null -44.6 .. +24.7 (noPath is noisy); base ~60/bot-h. BLOCKS KEEP.
NO-HARM: goto/explore/gather successes per bot-h DiD >= -6. Null -4.0 .. +2.9; base ~16/bot-h. BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED: danger-block episodes DiD (co-primary), guard refusals per check on the canary (unsampled), priced moves, deaths by family per arm (TWO-DEATH FLOOR: one death is named, never a verdict), deaths at map hazards by kind per arm (the warn-only treatment of drowning, cave falls and dripstone).

harm.note: Unchanged: the death gate (two deaths and > 1.25x control) and immobiledid gather_ratio.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. The lava-map.json files stay (base builds never read them); install-lavamap.sh --rollback removes them and the cron and header line if the change is abandoned. Rollback without a canary: LAVASIGHT=0.

extension.note: Tier 3: reads 180/360, KEEP from +360 when exposed, extend for exposure.
